performance.verdict: No paid activity; 5 overdue launch milestones block all revenue.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages all missed July 31 deadline — 3 blockers overdue 20+ days.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting both missed August 1 deadline — $6,500/mo planned spend is generating $0.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 over the last 3 days (Aug 17–19) vs. avg 4–6/day prior — the only active lead channel is now dark.
IG reach dropped 56% in 7d and is trending down: last 3 days avg 530 vs prior 3-day avg 826 — organic visibility shrinking across both channels.
GHL shows 492 contacts, 0 opportunities created, 0 appointments — pipeline is either unbuilt or intake is not routing contacts into stages.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid dollar can launch until blockers clear.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are confirmed overdue: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages (all missed July 31), and Ads Launch + Meta Retargeting (both missed August 1). Zero paid spend has occurred across 28 days against a $6,500/month budget plan. Nacer must provide a revised go-live date for each item by August 22. Success check: all 5 items marked complete in Monday and confirmed by Sohib before any ad spend is activated.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 492 contacts with 0 opportunities and 0 appointments signals intake routing is broken, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 492 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked over the 28-day window. This indicates pipeline stages, routing rules, or form-to-pipeline wiring were never completed or are misfiring. CRM lead should audit the contact-to-opportunity flow and confirm at least 1 test lead routes end-to-end into Clio Manage by August 22. Success check: first opportunity appears in GHL pipeline with a source tag and a Clio Manage record.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP daily actions; 3-day zero streak warrants profile audit before next check on August 23.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for three consecutive days (Aug 17–19) after averaging 4–6/day earlier in the period, and IG reach is down 56% week-over-week. No paid channels are live to compensate. Review the GBP profile for suspension flags, missing hours, or category changes before August 23. Success check: GBP actions return to 3+ per day by the next review cycle.
